scope: Evidence grades for each indexed VisualStyle source slot and candidate DXF emission field; paired writer observations are recorded separately from semantic group assignment and do not authorize DXF serialization.

gradeDefinitions.specified: A primary Autodesk DXF table lists the candidate value group for this conventional profile field.
gradeDefinitions.empirically-captured: The local decoder captures the field on the already-tracked AC1032 sample and generated source vectors verify the indexed primitive-to-model destination; this is not an independent semantic mapping proof.
gradeDefinitions.policy-qualified: A local same-profile DWG no-op encode is constrained by generated source vectors and exact body-bit replay; this says nothing about DXF output groups or external producer semantics.
gradeDefinitions.unresolved: The available evidence is a candidate, conflict, incomplete observation, or policy gap and cannot authorize output.
gradeDefinitions.empirically-observed: Literal behavior was compared in the exact paired-writer receipt. It establishes only what those outputs contained, not producer intent, field semantics, interoperability, or serializer eligibility.
gradeDefinitions.not-applicable: The indexed R2013b extension slots do not exist in the R2010b 28-slot profile, or a non-CMC slot has no CMC policy.

primaryDxfTable.scope: Conventional VisualStyle value groups; it does not define the R2013b 58-property extension or group-176 companions.

localSourceCapture.scope: One complete local AC1032 source profile is captured; it does not prove each typed field's independent semantics.

localDwgReplay.scope: Generated AC1024/AC1027/AC1032 vectors check typed slot destinations and exact same-profile encoded body bits.

candidateExtensionMap.source: Pinned LibreDWG source crosswalk; implementation evidence only, not a normative DXF contract or runtime writer result.

pairedWriterPrimaryTagSequence.observation: ODA File Converter 27.1.0.0 and LibreDWG dwg2dxf 0.14 emitted the same ordered primary group-code sequence for the Flat record across the 58 candidate slots from one tracked AC1032 input. The source producer is unknown; agreement is not semantic or normative proof.

pairedWriterGroup176Output.interpretation: Observed 58 ODA companions versus 56 LibreDWG companions; do not turn either into a group-176 serialization rule or relax the missing-slot conflict without an eligible producer/readback.

pairedWriterTupleComparison.interpretation: Captured writer-output differences only; values, CMC method/flags, group-420 high bits, group-177 policy and serializer admission remain unresolved.

sourcePathConflicts.reason: The primary table separately identifies group 421 as Face style mono color while listing 62/63 as Color; the candidate crosswalk's 63 mapping is not admitted without a producer-authored witness.
LibreDWG spec/generated metadata and importer disagree on value and companion groups; actual writer output is unknown.
